Vue 3.5.22 global production build (includes template compiler).
Source: https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/vue@3.5.22/dist/vue.global.prod.js
License: MIT; see vue.LICENSE. Files are served locally; no CDN request is made by the page.

Marked 18.1.1: https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/marked@18.1.1/lib/marked.umd.js
License: MIT; see marked.LICENSE.

DOMPurify 3.4.17: https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/dompurify@3.4.17/dist/purify.min.js
License: Apache-2.0 OR MPL-2.0; see dompurify.LICENSE.

All versions are pinned and served locally. Raw HTML and images in model answers are not enabled;
Markdown HTML is sanitized with an explicit allowlist before DOM insertion.
